Reach

187k reached, most never join a list

Your content reaches far more women than will ever book a call. Without a free class to sign up for, almost all of that attention leaves without an email address.

Readers

Book buyers belong to the bookstore

When someone buys The ADHD Awakening from a retailer, you don’t get her name or email. A reader who loved the book has no next step with you.

Calendar

Your calls do the filtering

A private call with no application in front of it gets booked by the curious as well as the committed. You find out which is which once you’re already on the call.

You already have the audience, the story and the book. What’s missing is the step in between that turns followers into buyers, and buyers into the right calls.

Does this sound familiar?

The diagnosis explained a lot. It didn’t come with instructions.

  • You spent years thinking you just needed to try harder.
  • You own every planner and app, and none of them stuck.
  • You hold it together at work, then crash when you get home.
  • You want to stop asking “what’s wrong with me?” and start asking “how do I work?”

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why a late diagnosis can feel like relief and grief at the same time

And why both feelings make sense, so you can stop judging yourself for having them.

Shift 1: from “lazy” to “differently wired”

How to replace the old story with one that actually helps you get things done.

Shift 2: from borrowed systems to your own

Why routines built for other brains keep failing, and how to design ones that fit yours.

Shift 3: from masking to self-trust

Small, practical ways to rebuild confidence in your own decisions.

Your next step

How to keep the momentum going after the class, on your own or with support.

Questions

Before you register

Is it really free?

Yes. The class, the live Q&A and the replay are all free.

What if I can’t make it live?

Register anyway. Everyone who signs up gets the replay by email.

Is this medical advice?

No. It’s coaching and education about mindset and day-to-day life. It doesn’t replace care from a doctor or licensed professional.

Who is it for?

Women who received an ADHD diagnosis as adults and want practical ways to work with their brain instead of against it.

Script 1 · “Try harder”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“So many women diagnosed with ADHD as adults were told the same thing for decades: just try harder.”

Body

“And they did. They built the colour-coded planners, downloaded every app, stayed up late catching up. It never stuck, and they blamed themselves. Here’s what I teach instead: the problem was never effort. It was trying to run on instructions written for a different brain. Change the story first, then the systems start to work.”

CTA

“I’m teaching the three mindset shifts that make that possible in a free live masterclass. Tap Sign up to save a seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, natural light, your usual setting. On-screen text: “just try harder?” Caption ends with “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 2 · “Relief and grief”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“A lot of women describe an adult ADHD diagnosis the same way: relief and grief, in the same week.”

Body

“Relief, because finally there’s a name for it. Grief, for all the years spent thinking they were the problem. Both feelings are normal. What helps most is what comes next: learning how your brain works, and building a life around that instead of around old expectations.”

CTA

“That’s exactly what my free masterclass covers. 60 minutes, live, with a replay. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, one cut to a text card: “relief” and “grief” side by side.

Script 3 · “Why I wrote the book”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I wrote a whole book for women who find out about their ADHD later in life. Here’s the part everyone asks about.”

Body

[Your own short story in two or three sentences, from your My Story highlight: why you wrote The ADHD Awakening]

“The biggest change isn’t a new system. It’s the moment the old story stops running the show. That’s what I now teach every client.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it live in a free masterclass. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: holding a copy of The ADHD Awakening, talking to camera. On-screen text: “the part everyone asks about”.
